_source: Live seed from catalyst:https://catalyst.example.com/content/entities/active (POST {"pointers":["0,0"]} -> deployed scene entity: id/type/pointers/content[]/metadata.display; verified 2026-06-23 HTTP 200, content has 1088 mappings). Entity/CRDT component model derived from decentraland/js-sdk-toolchain@main packages/@dcl/ecs (the @dcl/inspector source is not in the repo tree on main -- it consumes these @dcl/ecs core components): Transform (src/components/manual/Transform.ts, COMPONENT_ID=1, TransformType{position,rotation(quaternion),scale,parent}, identity = pos 0,0,0 / rot 0,0,0,1 / scale 1,1,1), Name (src/components/manual/Name.ts, 'core-schema::Name', {value:string}), and the LWW component registry in src/components/index.ts (Material, MeshRenderer, MeshCollider, GltfContainer, VisibilityComponent, TextShape, AudioSource, PointerEvents, Animator, Tween, LightSource, ...). Entity envelope shape from decentraland/schemas@main src/platform/entity.ts (Entity{version,id,type,pointers,timestamp,content[],metadata}). scene.json metadata shape from decentraland/sdk7-scene-template@main scene.json. The inspector composite is a CRDT 'main.composite' authored alongside scene.json (engine entities + LWW components). Editor EDITS (place item / set transform / add component / save composite) are SIMULATED in the XState wizard -- the catalyst content server is read-only over the public nginx (deployment requires a signed AuthChain POST to /content/entities which is auth-gated).
